text:
Anya: Noticed a small 95p latency uplift in hosted canary after enabling new batching.
Samir: Short requests queue longer; looks like batch_window changed.
Maria: CB2 increases aggregation window by default to save tokens  expected tradeoff.
Joel: Problem: older private/dedicated adapters drop unknown 'cb2' flag; control-plane currently elides it causing inconsistent behavior across pools.
Anya: We need deterministic mapping so tenants don't flip behavior mid-rollout.
Samir: Proposal: capability handshake + translation rules. If runtime doesn't support 'cb2', map to explicit legacy knobs (batch_window_ms, max_batch_size).
Maria: Add perf regression tests for KV cache warm-up when mapping happens.
Joel: Router should carry pool_features and prefer compatible pools when tenant opts into cb2.
infra-bot: Canary paused at 2809999000 for investigation.
Anya: Also emit audit events when control-plane maps or drops fields. Internal first, enterprise export opt-in later.
Samir: I'll draft capability + audit PR.
Maria: I'll run mapped-default perf runs against v1.12.
Joel: I'll prototype pool_features and routing preference.
Anya: Plan: pause, add handshake/audit/mapping, perf test, resume opt-in canary. Ping when PRs land. :thumbsup:
